purpose: Record public school-side evidence that links named schools or their broadcast-station channels to a campus song-request mini-program entry used by Campus Radio.

evidencePolicy.historicalProductNameRule: Historical product names such as 云点歌台 are recorded only when continuity with the current Campus Radio mini-program is verified; unrelated same-name products are excluded.

levels.A: School main official channel or publisher identity independently corroborated, with school-specific song-request instructions or interface evidence.
levels.B: School-affiliated broadcast/student channel or strong school-specific publication evidence, but not the school's main official account.
levels.C: Useful public evidence whose publisher relationship still needs independent corroboration.

schools.school: 贵州中医药大学时珍学院
schools.publisher: 贵州中医药大学时珍学院

publisherVerification.basis: The school's official website identifies 贵州中医药大学时珍学院 as its official WeChat account.

observedEvidence: The school-side article provides a QR-code entry for song requests.
The embedded mini-program screen shows 贵州中医药大学时珍学院 as the selected school.
The article instructs readers to confirm that the school name has switched to the school's song-request platform.
doesNotClaim: endorsement of every Campus Radio product claim
